candidates.explanation: confirmNewEmail builds the link with the '/confirm-email' path, the same one userSignUp uses for sign-up activation. The new-email confirmation link therefore opens the sign-up confirmation page, which calls the sign-up confirm endpoint (auth/email/confirm) and not auth/email/confirm/new. The email change is never completed. The path should be '/confirm-new-email'.

fix.description: In confirmNewEmail, change the URL path from '/confirm-email' to '/confirm-new-email'.
